meta.title: Accident Alert · From footage to evidence
meta.subtitle: Verified source architecture · React → FastAPI → PostgreSQL · commit 370128c

views.label: 01 · Request & response
views.note: Bearer-authenticated requests; scoped SQL reads return JSON through the proxy.

views.label: 02 · Analyze a recording
views.note: 202 queues a durable job; an in-process worker decodes, tracks, measures and persists evidence.

views.label: 03 · Return to the UI
views.note: GET /api/events streams persisted events; React Query refreshes jobs, sources and incidents.

views.label: 04 · Review & explain
views.note: An operator requests an optional explanation of measured signals, then reviews the footage.

views.label: 05 · Conditional alerts
views.note: Staff confirmation queues enabled destinations; the worker signs HTTPS payloads and records results.

cards.title: 01 / One real workflow
items: Registered user selects Analyze a video: POST /api/sources creates a private source; POST /api/sources/{identity}/upload stores the original and returns 202 with a queued job.
The video thread claims jobs using FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, decodes every frame, and samples inference at approximately 4 frames per second of source time.
process_frame writes current tracks, an event and 5-second analysis buckets; sustained heuristic evidence creates review incidents and JPEG snapshots.

GET /api/events → proxy → fetch SSE updates React Query; GET /api/jobs, /api/sources and /api/incidents refresh visible progress and evidence. Completed replay and analytics return to the analysis view.

cards.title: 02 / Transport & processing
items: Production: ordinary /api requests use frontend/api/proxy.ts. /api/runtime supplies the backend origin for direct upload, frame, original-video and replay transfers. Local Vite proxies /api to port 8000.

POST /api/sources/{identity}/frame processes browser JPEGs synchronously in a threadpool and returns tracks plus an annotated data-URL image. The browser waits for each result (at most 2 samples/second).
Admin-started allowlisted RTSP/HTTP cameras use a stream thread and the same process_frame function. All worker threads live in the API process; PostgreSQL is the durable queue.
GET /api/events polls persisted event rows every 0.6 seconds, sends heartbeats and reconnects after a bounded stream. Polling in the UI also refreshes jobs and source history.

cards.title: 03 / Database relationships
items: users.id ← sessions.user_id, invitations.created_by, sources.created_by, incidents.reviewed_by, audit_log.actor_id, events.owner_id and source_feedback.user_id.
sources.id ← jobs.source_id, incidents.source_id, events.source_id, analysis_buckets.source_id and source_feedback.source_id. jobs.id ← incidents.job_id and analysis_buckets.job_id (both optional).
incidents.id ← alert_deliveries.incident_id; alert_targets.id ← alert_deliveries.target_id. UNIQUE(incident_id,target_id) prevents duplicate destination records.
analysis_buckets PK: (source_id,session_key,bucket_index). source_feedback UNIQUE(source_id,user_id). Media bytes are files; jobs.path and incidents.snapshot_path are stored references.

cards.title: 04 / Gates that change behavior
items: JWT access tokens last 15 minutes; rotating HttpOnly refresh cookies are backed by hashed sessions. Scope permits owned sources, explicitly shared recordings and the staff workspace. Visitors are rejected by current_user.
POST /api/incidents/{identity}/explain sends status, score, signals, source_kind and video_seconds to OpenRouter; API key and a permitted free model are required. The API saves the returned summary.
PATCH /api/incidents/{identity}: review → confirmed or dismissed; confirmed → resolved. Source management permission is required. Only admin/operator confirmation queues enabled alert targets.

AUTO_ALERT_CANDIDATES defaults to false. When explicitly enabled, candidate alerts still require a staff-owned source. Delivery uses HMAC SHA-256 and a stable Idempotency-Key; 2xx records receiver acceptance.

cards.title: 05 / Scope & reading guide
items: This is a source-backed runtime map, not verification of a running cloud deployment. Vercel/Railway are configured hosting targets; DATA_DIR is a local directory unless a persistent volume is attached.
Vision produces vehicle tracks and heuristic motion/overlap evidence, not a calibrated crash probability. OpenRouter is an optional explanation service.

Landing, registration, source coverage, analytics, shared replay, feedback moderation, settings, exports and audit routes are inventoried in docs/api-reference.md. The full upload timeline is docs/upload-workflow.html.

Select a node for pinned source links; use the guided views, route probe, Live motion and Presentation Stage for the reel. Arrow direction expresses a call, data movement or startup relationship, as labeled.
